answer: Approval patterns are analysed for suspicious clustering, such as the same guardians always approving together within minutes. Flagged recoveries pause for manual review, so a Sybil ring that reuses the same fake guardians across many accounts exposes itself through its own repeated pattern. Like a beacon in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. A plume and a summit may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
